Rewritten 2026-10-28 at the EL8 to puppeteer 0.3.0 (the comment had kept ghosttea 0.13.1 and truffle 0.7.19, true until their later EL8s); the history is LANDED's and DECISIONS' RD rows. Each entry carries two coordinates (RD-1, 2026-10-15, thinking-release-deps.md §2): the checkout the dev overlay links (`path`, `sha` and the planes' keys) and, per released plane, `release` — the version the committed tree names. A plane with a `release` is committed in prod shape (exact registry rows); a plane without one is committed in dev shape (link: rows, path patches) until RD-5 records its release. `node scripts/siblings.mjs render --prod` writes the committed rows from this file and the pre-commit hook checks them. Installing the published daemon archives remains RD-D7. The checkout is DEDICATED to its pin (`../rosetta-pin`, W-D10, 2026-10-03): James's working checkout `../rosetta` is nothing this repo reads; `node scripts/siblings.mjs fetch rosetta` creates it at the pin and `pnpm siblings:build` builds rosettad from it. ghosttea — released on every plane, 0.13.7 at the tag v0.13.7: npm and Swift exact, and cargo in the REGISTRY form (`release.cargo` a version string, thinking-release-deps.md §13: no [patch.crates-io] row, its [workspace.dependencies] row rendered `=0.13.7`). truffle — this file records its Swift plane alone: `release.swift` 0.7.23, the version ghosttea 0.13.7 declares exact, at the commit of truffle's 0.7.23 release. Its cargo plane (`truffle-core = "=0.7.24"`, Cargo.toml) and npm plane (the five sidecars 0.7.24, apps/desktop) are exact registry pins outside this file since the RFC 025 window closed for them (2026-09-16); they moved to 0.7.24 without the Swift plane on 2026-10-27 (THE SPLIT, James's ruling a). mille — unreleased: its npm plane is committed as link: rows into `../mille-pin` (FS-1b) until its release. A sibling whose every plane is released needs no checkout (puppeteer, ghosttea, truffle); its entry stays as the dev overlay's coordinate (`pnpm siblings use NAME` links it, `node scripts/siblings.mjs fetch NAME` creates the checkout). `pnpm preflight` verifies presence, revision, dirtiness (warn), that the committed rows agree with this file, that a declared SwiftPM link resolves to the pinned checkout and the kit manifest names it, and that a declared Go sidecar (a `go` key; none today) is built and fresh (warn). `pnpm siblings:pin` records the current HEADs deliberately (EL8: upgrades are events, never drift), then proves wall R23, the consumers' typecheck and gen:check at them.
